props.label: Ford Ranger Ute Hire in Melbourne

data.name: Ford Ranger Long-Term Hire
data.description: Long-term ute hire across Melbourne. A Ford Ranger dual cab with an open tub, seating for five and room for the tools, gear and materials of a working week.

mainEntity.name: How much does the Ford Ranger cost to hire?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Ford Ranger is $280 per week including GST, with 1,400 km included each week and a $500 bond.

mainEntity.name: How many people does it seat?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Ranger is a dual cab and seats 5 including the driver.
Yes, the Ranger is an automatic.

mainEntity.name: Can I hire it long-term for work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It is popular with trades and small businesses that need a ute on flexible weekly and monthly terms, with no long lock-in contract.
